descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S20 Double tap on Save & Extract, and the same note pasted twice

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 From an explicitly pasted or photographed prior note, the background, active issues, imaging and diagnostic tests are extracted correctly and update that patient's chart. (UAT TC-13; TFA-92591 AC 1; TFA-92591 How it works 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Fresh physician with the fixture Hospital patient

When Paste the S02 note dated 'Oct 11' and double-click Save & Extract (one browser_click with doubleClick: true). Then paste the same note again with the same date and press Save & Extract

Then No duplicated chart rows: one chest X-ray row and one TTE row on Diagnostic Testing, the background not doubled, no duplicate issues, and no error left on screen

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Not judged until oracle.mjs has a count check or a post-run rounding:get read exists; presence checks alone cannot fail on a duplicate. Then: radiology has length 2 (one chest X-ray, one TTE); the background contains 'CKD stage 3' exactly once (admissionSummary.reason not repeated); importantPoints with source 'prior-note' are not duplicated; …

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S20 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-13.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
